{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Arborville |characters=ハテノ村 |japanese=Hateno Village |image=Arborville.png |caption=Arborville |imagesize=300px |region=Johto |epicode=M04 |episode=Celebi: The Voice of the Forest }} '''Arborville''' (Japanese: '''ハテノ村''' ''Hateno Village'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Johto]] [[region]] and one of the settings of ''[[M04|Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]''. ==Geography== [[File:A house in Arborville.png|thumb|left|220px|[[Towa]]'s house]] [[File:Lake of Life forest entrance.png|thumb|220px|A fallen tree with a cut through tunnel leads to the [[Lake of Life]]]] The treetop village lies close to the [[Lake of Life]], home to the [[Mythical Pokémon]] {{OBP|Celebi|M04}} who is regarded as "Voice of the Forest" by Arborville's residents. The residents of Arborville respect the surrounding forest and watch over one of its main entrances for weary travelers and troublesome [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poachers]]. According to animated series maps,[''needs links''] Arborville is located just north of [[Olivine City]]. Known residents of Arborville include [[Towa]], {{OBP|Diana|M04}}, and [[Mr. White]]. It bears a remarkable similarity to [[Fortree City]], a city in [[Hoenn]] that was featured in {{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s}} three years later. Just like Fortree City, all of Arborville's houses are built in trees. {{left clear}} ==History== {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} passed through Arborville after learning that the area was home to many rare [[wild Pokémon]]. They befriended [[Sam]], a boy who had been transported 40 years into the future by Celebi. Before they could help him return to his own time they had to contend with the [[Iron-Masked Marauder]], a Pokémon poacher intent on capturing Celebi. He succeeded in catching Celebi in a [[Dark Ball]], corrupting the Pokémon into destroying the forest.
